adjudications.findingObjectiveReason: The theorist calls his phrase an alternative expansion of the KЧС acronym. In Swahili the approved KHD initials do not match Ibada ya Kifo cha Binadamu; claiming it is a decoding of KHD creates a false initialism. The constrained proposal presents it as a dark wordplay on the name while preserving both the approved KHD form and the cult-of-human-death meaning.
adjudications.adjudicationReason: Objective source-to-target defect confirmed in source and scene context.
